answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x target and began after the day-74 release, while daily settlement peak is a known load shape that previously required headroom rather than implying a new region or read-replica issue. Rollback is the intervention that historically cleared a post-release checkout regression without dropping customer writes; circuit breaking is rejected because fail-fast on this path would sacrifice writes. Cause is still ambiguous (release vs peak saturation), so only b1 and b3 are pulled for archive checks and the rollback is limited to a small guarded cohort rather than a full cutover.
